data.name: Starcrest Saga
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap

We're releasing this collection in increments! While we don't have a specific release date planned for this game, we are working hard to ensure a unique experience at a fair price. We intend on adding more games to the collection!


About the Game

Starcrest Saga

Explore the universe of Starcrest in this collection of Mega Drive action/adventure games. Follow Alia Nassar's journey across the Surya Star System as the story unfolds over multiple games. The collection is currently planned to include the following titles:

Starcrest - Action/Adventure

System: Mega Drive
Release Year: COMING SOON

Gameplay

Explore the planet Sita in a metroidvania-like action adventure. Play as Alia Nassar, a young Neuminn from Metsi Village, as she sets out on the journey that begins the Starcrest Saga (TM!!!!!)

Starcrest 2 - Action/Adventure

System: Mega Drive
Release Year: COMING SOON

Gameplay

Taking place 10 years after the events of Starcrest, Starcrest 2 follows the now 20-year-old Alia as she struggles with family conflict and self-doubt. Journey beyond Sita and explore multiple planets throughout the Surya Star System, each with its own environments, inhabitants, and challenges.

Starcrest 3 - Action/Adventure

System:

Release Year:
